mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.order_type, o.order_date, o.supplier_id, o.department, o.order_status, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.operator, o.confirm_by, o.confirm_time, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, s.supplier_name from med_stock_order o left join med_supplier s on s.supplier_id = o.supplier_id
mapper.select: select order_id, order_no, order_type, order_date, supplier_id, department, order_status, total_qty, total_amount, operator, confirm_by, confirm_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from med_stock_order where order_id = #{orderId} for update

select i.item_id, i.order_id, i.med_id, i.batch_id, i.batch_no, i.produce_date, i.expire_date, i.quantity, i.unit_price, i.amount, m.med_code, m.med_name, m.med_spec, m.unit, b.remain_qty from med_stock_order_item i left join med_info m on m.med_id = i.med_id left join med_stock_batch b on b.batch_id = i.batch_id where i.order_id = #{orderId} order by i.item_id
mapper.insert: insert into med_stock_order (order_no, order_type, order_date, supplier_id, department, order_status, total_qty, total_amount, operator, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{orderNo}, #{orderType}, #{orderDate}, #{supplierId}, #{department}, #{orderStatus}, #{totalQty}, #{totalAmount}, #{operator}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update med_stock_order set order_date = #{orderDate}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, department = #{department}, total_qty = #{totalQty}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, operator = #{operator}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where order_id = #{orderId} and order_status = '0'

update med_stock_order set order_status = '1', confirm_by = #{confirmBy}, confirm_time = #{confirmTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and order_status = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into med_stock_order_item (order_id, med_id, batch_id, batch_no, produce_date, expire_date, quantity, unit_price, amount) values (#{orderId}, #{medId}, #{batchId}, #{batchNo}, #{produceDate}, #{expireDate}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{amount})
mapper.update: update med_stock_order_item set batch_id = #{batchId} where item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.delete: delete from med_stock_order where order_id = #{orderId} and order_status = '0'
mapper.select: select batch_id, med_id, supplier_id, batch_no, produce_date, expire_date, batch_qty, remain_qty, purchase_price, batch_status from med_stock_batch where batch_id = #{batchId} for update

select batch_id, med_id, supplier_id, batch_no, produce_date, expire_date, batch_qty, remain_qty, purchase_price, batch_status from med_stock_batch where med_id = #{medId} and batch_no = #{batchNo} order by batch_id limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update med_stock_batch set batch_qty = ifnull(batch_qty, 0) + #{quantity}, remain_qty = ifnull(remain_qty, 0) + #{quantity}, purchase_price = #{unitPrice}, in_time = sysdate(), batch_status = '0', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where batch_id = #{batchId}
update med_stock_batch set remain_qty = remain_qty + #{quantity}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where batch_id = #{batchId} and remain_qty + #{quantity} <= batch_qty
mapper.select: select count(1) from med_info where med_id = #{medId} and status = '0'
select count(1) from med_supplier where supplier_id = #{supplierId} and status = '0'
